description: This file contains functions related to preparing and submitting a new model deployment request in a UI component. It handles form data processing, request preparation, and invoking network API calls to create models on the backend.

methods.name: prepareModelAddRequest
methods.description: Assembles deployment configuration objects from form values and mappings, handling special cases like wildcards, pricing conversions, and JSON parsing for extra parameters.

methods.name: handleAddModelSubmit
methods.description: High-level function to handle form submission: prepares deployment configs, calls API to create models, and manages UI state, with error handling.
